summary: Brera Holdings PLC filed a Form 6-K on May 12, 2026, announcing a 1-for-10 reverse share split approved by the board on May 1, 2026, and by shareholders at an EGM on April 7, 2026. No price, premium, or value is stated. The split is intended to regain compliance with Nasdaq's minimum bid price rule of $1 per share. There is no board recommendation or advisor named. Equiniti Trust Company acts as transfer agent. The split is structural/corporate action, not an event-driven special situation.
